title: Sizzle Acquisition Corp. II 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Sizzle Acquisition Corp. II (SZZL), a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026 announcing execution of a Business Combination Agreement with Trasteel Holding S.A., a Luxembourg company. At closing, Trasteel shareholders will receive $800 million in Pubco Ordinary Shares valued at $10.00 per share, and the SPAC will merge with a to-be-formed Cayman Islands subsidiary.
key_points: Sizzle Acquisition Corp. II is a SPAC trading on Nasdaq under symbols SZZLU, SZZL, and SZZLR.
Business Combination Agreement dated April 13, 2026 with Trasteel Holding S.A. (Luxembourg company).
Trasteel shareholders will receive $800,000,000 in Pubco Ordinary Shares at $10.00 per share.
Upon closing, each SZZL unit will separate into Class A ordinary shares and rights, with rights converted to Class A shares.
Sizzle Class B ordinary shares will automatically convert to Class A ordinary shares prior to closing.
The filing includes a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and investor presentation (Exhibit 99.2).
